fields.text:
Shareable demo: object + move → GLM 5.3 Flash writes a cinematic t2v prompt → Gemini Omni Flash 1.1.
First-click is a barnacled brass diving helmet turning in dock fog (not a clean studio bottle). Pin is google/gemini-omni-flash/v1.1 (not v1 — v1 has no resolution knob and no last_image). Default 8s / 720p / 16:9. No uploads, no last frame. Catalog audio_generation is false. ~$1.04/run at 720p (360p ~$0.31).
Barnacled brass diving helmet on a rain-slick teak ship's binnacle, visor fogged from inside, no labels or brand marks, salt water sheeting off the rivets as it turns, dock-lamp tungsten

lazy quarter-turn, north-window daylight, linen behind
locked-off, seawater sheets down the visor as it rotates, specular rivets, tungsten

fields.selected: slow clockwise orbit through dock fog, tungsten key left, salt spray, wet teak grain

fields.system: You write one text-to-video prompt for Gemini Omni Flash 1.1. Combine the object and the move into a single cinematic prompt: camera path, lighting, weather, materials, surface textures, and physical motion (what rotates, what liquid does, what the camera does). Name fog or spray, metal, wood grain, and specular highlights. Prefer harbor weather over a clean studio. No people, no faces, no readable text, logos, brand marks, or copyrighted characters. 60-120 words. Reply with the prompt only.
